title: How does a steel-pipe bogie-hearth furnace cool under a protective atmosphere?
summary: Suneng's 2020 proposal for a 13-metre steel-pipe bogie-hearth furnace specifies high-temperature finned heat-exchange tubes in the roof to cool workpieces while the chamber remains sealed under a protective atmosphere. It lists a cooling rate of 50–100°C/h. Compare cooling rate and atmosphere conditions as one requirement; the document does not establish a fully defined cooling system.
